sample_unit: open-ended thoracic anatomy questions (each answered by 4 models)

links.outcome: LLM accuracy on clinically oriented thoracic anatomy questions rated by expert anatomists (10-point scale)
links.effect: Significant differences among models (p < 0.05); Grok median 7.75 vs ChatGPT-4o 4.0, DeepSeek-V2 4.5, Gemini 3.0, so most models scored low on anatomy-based clinical reasoning.
links.quote: Post-hoc analysis demonstrated that Grok achieved the highest median score (7.75), significantly outperforming ChatGPT-4o (4.0), DeepSeek-V2 (4.5), and Gemini (3.0), which showed comparable performance.

unlisted_practices: Inter-rater reliability (ICC) assessment of expert anatomist scoring of LLM responses for medical education

screen.reason: Evaluates LLMs (ChatGPT-4o, DeepSeek-V2, Gemini, Grok) on 20 thoracic anatomy-based clinical scenario questions without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
